title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-riley-thompson-2026-03-25
body:
Release train weekly prep notes - 2026-03-25
Owner: Riley Thompson (release-engineering)
Attendees (expected): Samir Patel, Maya Singh, Jordan Lee, Olivia Martin (SRE), Priya Kapoor (Product)
Objective: Quick go/no-go sanity check before go-window next Tue 2026-03-31. Validate blockers, owners, and immediate action items.

Quick status summary:
- Overall readiness: 80% (QA tests passing 92% on main; upgrade path validated on staging)
- Big open risk: Canary infra quota + DB migration timing under load
- Cutoff for code freeze: 2026-03-27 17:00 PT

Go / No-Go checklist (short form) - call will confirm per-item:
1) Critical PRs merged and smoke-tested (owner: Samir Patel) -> MOST merged; 2 remaining (PR#341 flaky test; PR#342 infra config)
2) End-to-end QA (owner: Maya Singh) -> smoke stable on staging, full regression running, ETA 2026-03-25 EOD
3) DB migration plan signed off (owner: Jordan Lee) -> migration script ready; need final SRE timing confirmation
4) Canary infra reserved (owner: Olivia Martin) -> pending quota request approval (ticket opened)
5) Rollback plan documented & tested (owner: Riley Thompson) -> draft done, need dry-run on staging 2026-03-26
6) Monitoring + Alerting configured (owner: Olivia Martin) -> dashboards done, alert thresholds TODO
7) Customer comms / release notes (owner: Priya Kapoor) -> draft ready, needs final features list
8) Security sign-off (owner: Security) -> in progress, on track

Blockers / Risks (short):
- Quota issue for canary nodes (high) -> block for canary testing; SRE escalation in progress (Olivia). ETA 2026-03-26 mid-day. If not resolved, fallback: reduce canary % and extend canary duration.
- Flaky integration test (medium) -> PR#341 causing intermittent failures in CI. Dev triage assigned to Samir; hotfix timeline 1 business day.
- DB migration under load (medium-high) -> need confirmed maintenance window and pre-copy plan. Jordan to run dry-run during low-traffic window (scheduled 2026-03-26 02:00 PT).

Deployment plan highlights:
- Deployment window: 2026-03-31 00:00 - 04:00 PT (primary)
- Canary: start at 1% -> 5% after 15m -> 25% after 60m -> 100% after 3h (adjust if regressions)
- Rollback window: immediate rollback to previous model/image within the first 60m if error budget breach >0.5% or latency spikes >30%
- Post-deploy verification runbook: smoke tests (2m), full acceptance suite (30m), phonedown on critical metrics for 2h

Communications:
- Incident channel: #release-rt and #sre-oncall (Olivia to add temporary subscriptions)
- Exec heads-up: 1h before Canary (Priya to send)
- Customer announcement: scheduled after 100% rollout; comms draft by Priya

Action items (triaged, with owners and due dates):
- Samir: finish merge + fix flaky test (PR#341) -> due 2026-03-25 EOD
- Samir: merge infra PR#342 after Olivia approves config -> due 2026-03-25 15:00 PT
- Maya: finish full regression and report blocker list -> due 2026-03-25 EOD
- Jordan: run DB migration dry-run on staging 2026-03-26 02:00 PT; report metrics and time estimate -> due 2026-03-26 08:00 PT
- Olivia: escalate canary quota with cloud provider, confirm allocation or fallback plan -> due 2026-03-26 12:00 PT
- Riley: schedule rollback dry-run on staging and document final rollback steps -> due 2026-03-26 EOD
- Priya: finalize release notes and exec copy -> due 2026-03-26 12:00 PT
- Security: finalize sign-off on migration/permissions -> due 2026-03-26 EOD

Notes to self / meeting prompts:
- Ask SRE for exact quota SLA and backup plan if provider delays (Olivia)
- Confirm with Product if any last-minute scope cuts are acceptable and which features are mandatory for launch
- Re-verify observability thresholds (latency, error rate, CPU) and set automated rollback triggers
- Prepare short script to run rollback (time estimate + checklist)
- Consider canary duration extension if initial canary shows borderline errors (have approval path documented)

Follow-ups after today's sync (post-meeting):
- If PRs not merged, convene 30m hotfix session with dev + QA -> Samir/Maya
- If canary quota not approved, run contingency: reduced canary + longer monitoring + manual approvals at 25% and 100%
- If DB dry-run shows >10% slow-down under load, re-evaluate migration cutover and push launch by 48 hours

Meeting agenda (10-15m prep for sync):
- 0:00 - 0:02: Quick status round (owners state go/no-go for their area)
- 0:02 - 0:06: Highlight blockers and who owns the mitigations
- 0:06 - 0:10: Confirm action items and deadlines; confirm freeze time
- 0:10 - 0:12: Decision: clear to proceed to final prep / needs escalation / postpone
- 0:12 - 0:15: Quick AOB (communication needs, exec briefing)

Misc (scratch):
- Possible follow-up: schedule on-call shadow for first 4 hours of rollout (Olivia + backup)
- Remember to attach load graphs from last week to the Confluence page for context

Draft for meeting note headline (to paste into Slack after):
"Release train check-in: MAJOR readiness at 80% — blockers: canary quota, flaky CI test, DB migration dry-run. Action owners assigned; next update after regression + quota confirmation (ETA 2026-03-25 EOD)."

End of notes.
